name: pixel-studio-helper
description: Plan, generate, validate, and prepare pixel-art assets for import into Pixel Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare pixel-art assets for Pixel Studio.
interface.longDescription: Pixel Studio Helper turns an asset brief into a clear pixel-art specification, a constrained palette, and an export-ready raster workflow. It can validate dimensions, transparency, and color count, but it does not claim to control the native Pixel Studio window.
interface.defaultPrompt: Prepare this pixel-art asset for Pixel Studio: describe the sprite, canvas size, palette, transparency, and export requirements.
